summary: AstraZeneca furnished a routine 6-K disclosing a positive CHMP opinion recommending EU approval of Enhertu (trastuzumab deruxtecan) as adjuvant monotherapy for adults with resected HER2-positive early breast cancer and residual invasive disease after neoadjuvant taxane-based and HER2-targeted therapy. The opinion rests on DESTINY-Breast05 Phase III data showing a 53% reduction in invasive disease recurrence or death versus T-DM1 (HR 0.47), with 92.4% three-year invasive disease-free survival. Enhertu is jointly developed and commercialised with Daiichi Sankyo. No transaction, no deal terms, no board recommendation; this is a routine regulatory pipeline disclosure, not a special situation.
